opening.argument: The speaker promotes paid participation through a $45 Genesis Mining contract to begin mining Ethereum, while also presenting BitClub Network as a "team build opportunity" and describing bringing people into the network. He connects the mining opportunity to an approximate 2.75% return and suggests a possible nine-times increase, framing these paid options as support for his growing business. Although he says he is educating rather than selling, the substance is a direct promotion of paid participation, including using one paid service to enter the other network.
